notes: This source/test traceability contract covers the bounded IEEE 1516.1-2025 Subscribe Object Class Attributes service in Umbra's opt-in, non-installable development profile. Its focused production-filesystem regression adds the successful-void service-report boundary: an undefined object class appends nothing, while an accepted passive subscription with the real Restaurant FOM High rate appends ObjectClassHandle type 36, AttributeHandleSet type 1, Boolean type 6 Optional passive subscription indicator, and String type 53 Optional update rate designator. A later default-rate subscription emits the same required arguments, a false passive indicator, and a type-34 Null optional update-rate slot. The public C++ active selector is inverted for the standards-facing passive indicator. The Lab exports the update-rate continuation candidates under §5.9 even though their §5.8 source precedes that next-service heading; RL-080 records this cross-page ownership mismatch. Complete discovery/scope/relevance/advisory matrices, generic return/failure representations, MOM interaction delivery, timestamped behavior, save/restore, DDM, remote transport, catalog evidence, validation, and conformance remain outside this slice.
